name: launchpath-skills
description: Skills for network admins, coaches, and church planters using the LaunchPath (Church Planting Checklist) MCP server. Covers network health dashboards and bottleneck alerts, per-coach oversight of assigned plants, planter roadmap views, weekly planning and task triage, plus the monthly scorecard: key vitals, faithful actions, and network check-in review. Bundles the LaunchPath MCP connector (https://churchplantingchecklist.com/api/mcp); installing it prompts you to sign in.
